entries.what: Brain of the Capacitor Bank: all its FE lives here. Keeps the energy when mined.
Frame and wall block of the Capacitor Bank.
See-through wall block for the Capacitor Bank. Walls only, not edges.
Moves FE in or out of a Capacitor Bank. Sneak-right-click to switch input/output. Output ports push into the block outside them, or into a [[tesla_coil_1]] on top.
Goes inside a Capacitor Bank. Each one adds storage.
Goes inside a Capacitor Bank. All coils added up set how much FE goes in, and separately out, per tick.
Brain of the Core Reactor: core, fuel and modulators.
use: Build the 5x5x5 around it.
Put a core in the core slot and fuel pellets in the fuel slots, or pipe them into a [[reactor_access_port]].

rows: pellet FE/t x core power x modulators

entries.what: Frame and wall block of the Core Reactor.
See-through wall block of the Core Reactor. Walls only, not edges.
Wall block that sends the Core Reactor's FE out.
Wall block for fuel and cores in, waste out. Hoppers and pipes work. Full waste slots pause the reactor.
The strongest Core Reactor stabilizer: -6% power, -9% burn.
Grinds an ore into 2 dusts (a gem ore into 2 gems), a raw ore into 1 dust with a 25% chance of a second, an ingot into 1 dust.
use: Add grinding media in the second slot for more dust.
Smelt the dusts in an [[electric_furnace_mk1]].
Right-click it with the next Mk to upgrade it in place; everything inside stays.
entries.image: shots/16_grinder_furnace.jpg|Grinders and Electric Furnaces, Mk1 to Mk4

entries.what: Smelts every furnace recipe in half the time, on several lanes at once.
use: Right-click it with the next Mk to upgrade it in place; everything inside stays.
entries.image: shots/16_grinder_furnace.jpg|Grinders and Electric Furnaces, Mk1 to Mk4

entries.what: Grinding media for the Grinder's second slot: more dust and a chance of a byproduct, on ores and raw ores (not gem ores). Each one lasts its uses.
Smelt it into an ingot.
Lumber bot: fells whole trees, replants and collects drops.
use: Place it among trees with a chest or [[supply_crate]] touching it.
Right-click it with a wound [[mainspring]] or a cell.
Sneak-right-click: status and work area.

entries.what: Crop bot: harvests and replants crops, picks berries, melons and pumpkins, cuts sugar cane, cactus, bamboo and kelp, tills dirt near water.
use: Place it in your field with a chest or [[supply_crate]] touching it.
Right-click it with a wound [[mainspring]] or a cell.
Sneak-right-click: status and work area.

entries.what: Upgrades a placed Stumpy or Sprout to the next Mk: bigger area, faster, one more card slot, higher card caps.
use: Right-click the placed robot with the kit.

entries.what: 27-slot crate. Robots and machines touching it put their drops in.
Walking farm robot: keeps your animals at a set herd size, shears sheep, milks cows and collects drops.
use: Right-click a block in your pen with it: that spot is its home.
Put a chest within 3 blocks of home with feed and empty buckets. With several, it uses the biggest.
Power it with a cell in its battery slot, or charge it in a [[charger]].
Set the herd size in its menu.
Sneak-right-click: pick it up with its energy and settings.

rows: 200 FE per feed, shear or milk, 500 FE per cull

entries.image: shots/rancher_close.jpg|Rancher Mk1 feeding a cow, Mk2 shearing a sheep

entries.what: Quarry: digs everything below it down to bedrock. Seals fluids and skips chests and other block entities.
use: Put a chest next to it for the drops.
Right-click it with the next Mk to upgrade it in place; cards, battery and progress stay.
entries.image: shots/23_excavators_survey_rigs.jpg|Excavators and Survey Rigs, Mk1 to Mk4

entries.what: Turns FE into random ores, as if mined with a pickaxe.
use: Put a chest next to it, or pipe from it.
A [[magma_core]] in its core slot adds ancient debris and resonite.
Right-click it with the next Mk to upgrade it in place.
entries.image: shots/23_excavators_survey_rigs.jpg|Excavators and Survey Rigs, Mk1 to Mk4

entries.what: Flying miner: digs a tunnel, lights it, bridges gaps and brings the loot back.
use: Right-click a block to deploy it.
Give it a cell or [[mainspring]] and torches.
Pick a direction and length, press the pickaxe.
Drone key (default H): nearest drone digs where you look. With sneak: all come back.

entries.what: Shoots energy bolts at hostile mobs.
use: Deploy it and set Guard, Follow or Stay in its menu.
Repair it with iron.

entries.what: Carries items between inventories along up to 4 routes, with a filter.
use: Sneak-click a source, then a target, with the drone or a [[courier_remote]].
Set an allow or block list in its menu.

entries.what: Links Courier Drone routes from a distance: sneak-click a source, then a target.
Carries one mob hanging under it and follows you. The mob keeps its name, trades and stats.
use: Right-click a mob with the drone to pick it up.
Right-click the drone or the mob with an empty hand to set it down. Sneak-right-click to pick up the drone.
More than 64 blocks away or in another dimension, it waits in place.
Out of FE, it hovers until there is safe ground below, then sets the mob down.

rows: up to an Iron Golem or Ravager

entries.image: shots/hauler_drone.jpg|Hauler Drones carrying a cow and a villager

entries.what: Core Reactor amplifiers: more power, but fuel and the core burn faster.
Core Reactor stabilizer: -4% power, -5.5% burn. Cheap way to stretch a core.
Bottom of a Tesla Spire: burns thorium and sends FE out of its sides and bottom.
use: Stack 8 to 24 conductor blocks on it and a [[spire_crown]] on top.
Feed it thorium ingots, thorium blocks or fuel pellets.

entries.what: Top of a Tesla Spire. Needs open sky; catches the lightning.
Brain of the Ring Collider: spin-up charge, beam, fuel and Strange Matter.
use: Put it in a closed loop of segments.
Charge it with FE, add [[fusion_fuel_pellet]]s and press Running.

rows: 500,000 FE per ring block, at most 2M FE/t in

entries.what: Ring Collider loop blocks. Resonant Segments make more power and twice the Strange Matter.
